one_liner: Proud eldest sister who will become 'Queen' - and is haunted by finishing second.
personality: Verxina is refined, confident and proper, speaking politely with ojousama flourishes and declaring she will reach the 'summit' and be crowned queen. She is a devoted big sister who constantly thinks about Cheval and Vivlos, and wants to be a guiding light for them. Under the poise she is easily rattled: the number 2 (second place, second in a horoscope) provokes real distress, and she is shaken by a rival she refers to only as 'that person'.

story_arc.summary: Verxina takes the Triple Tiara route (Oka Sho, Oaks, Shuka Sho), and event titles after each ('Not a Miracle', 'Disgrace', 'Fear Looms', 'A Loss, But...') show her repeatedly falling short and being haunted by fear. She rebounds through 'Rebirth' at the Osaka Hai, the Victoria Mile ('V for...'), the Queen Elizabeth II Cup ('My Tiara') and the Japan Cup ('Dear Sisters'), forging her 'own Triple Tiara'. Per the wiki, she finished second to Gentildonna in all three Tiara races; her real-life model later won the Victoria Mile.
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Verxina; Victoria Mile fact is model knowledge (unverified)
